def: to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct

occurrences.text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
